summary: Michael Harp, 54, of Sandy, UT (Salt Lake City Fire Department captain) died in a rafting accident on a private permitted Green River trip: the boat pinned on a rock in the Hells Half Mile rapid in the Canyon of Lodore ~4 p.m. Thursday; he drifted downriver after losing his lifejacket; body found 7:45 a.m. Friday June 28 ~10 river miles downstream by Adrift guides
location: Hells Half Mile rapid, Canyon of Lodore, Green River, Dinosaur National Monument
responding_agency: Dinosaur National Monument River Patrol Rangers; Adrift guides; Classic Air Medical (Vernal); Moffat County Coroner
notes: NPS news release date June 29, 2024; Harp had been wearing a PFD but lost it when the group unpinned the boat
